conclusion: Full passed5/6 primary trials; compact4/6. Smaller compact tool responses did not improve task success. Keep opt-in; no superiority or release-quality claim.
limitations: Three selected public framework-API tasks, two repetitions each; too small for causal or broad product claims.
Actual client used lookup, not codebase_retrieve; this evaluates evidence rendering/default choice, not retrieval ranking.
Compact lookup receives1200 estimated-token budget; existing full lookup is unbounded. Identical-budget ranking/assembly comparison is the separate168-case corpus experiment.
No mode overrides or full SHA-guarded follow-ups were requested in primary trials.
No compact query argument was supplied by these agents; query-relevant selection is exercised by the separate fixed-query corpus and regression cases.
cl100k counts MCP text and reconstructed complete JSON separately; neither is assumed to be Claude model-visible token count.
Provider usage includes repeated input/cache tokens; reported cost is list-price estimate, not billed charge.
Two concurrent trials make wall time descriptive only.
Failures remain in the report; no outcome-dependent retries.
Full raw transcripts and app source responses retained locally; only hashes, metrics and method names are published here.
